issues.problem: The full saved token can reassemble in page-readable result text after the background redaction pass. The current echo tests cover HTML and Markdown delimiters but miss paragraph separation and invisible format characters.
issues.fix: Match credentials across layout and format separators before sending result text to content scripts. Add regressions that check both the worker message and the rendered shadow-root text with a dummy credential.

issues.problem: The first request can analyze a line with different castling rights from the exact board FEN. The regression currently requires that wrong request before it checks for a warning.
issues.fix: Reconcile the selected line with exact castling and en-passant state before sending, and offer the exact board fallback when reconciliation fails. Derive the post-move rights when checking Explain, bind cached or coalesced validation to the complete snapshot, and change the fixture to reject any initial POST of the discrepant line.

issues.problem: An unrelated visible sidebar result can open the gate for the active board. A CSS-hidden result can separately expose the launcher.
issues.fix: Scope completion evidence to the current game and main board, reject conflicting active-game signals, and make launcher and click-time eligibility agree. Add direct-entry and SPA tests with stale, unrelated and CSS-hidden result markers, asserting zero POSTs.

issues.problem: Global whitespace removal repairs malformed SAN, and a narrow colour filter can treat user marks as last-move squares.
issues.fix: Trim padding only at the known figurine and move-text boundary. Use a positive marker for last-move highlights where available, and show the side picker when the source cannot be distinguished. Preserve both recorded live-markup cases in the regression suite.

issues.problem: A primitive snapshot throws inside the worker's validation path.
issues.fix: Require a non-array object with the allowed keys and explicitly typed fields before using the snapshot. Add malformed-message tests that assert a typed rejection and zero fetches.

issues.problem: Closed-panel work scans several selectors and PGN fields each tick, even once at hidden startup. The moving-board retry path can delay open-panel feedback beyond 300 ms.
issues.fix: Update cached eligibility from relevant page changes and skip startup work while hidden. Publish the moving state promptly while keeping position reads rate-limited. Verify hidden-tab work and change-to-update latency.

issues.problem: The narrow-view tests exercise viewport resizing but leave true 200% zoom unverified for both the panel and Settings.
issues.fix: Add 200% browser-zoom runs that check reading order, overflow, keyboard focus and target sizes on both surfaces.

issues.problem: A Retry-After countdown can be bypassed by the normal ask controls or another tab.
issues.fix: Keep the retry deadline per origin in the worker and apply it across request paths. Display the remaining wait and test alternate buttons and clients.

issues.problem: Accepted evaluation prose can omit the side, and the result screenshots omit a `promising_or_analysis` source case.
issues.fix: Render a supported side attribution for evaluation text or omit the row when attribution is unknown. Add the missing source screenshot regression.

issues.problem: The stale warning and re-ask split the analysed-position context from the result headline.
issues.fix: Render the headline immediately after the context and place the stale warning and its action after it.

issues.problem: The policy overstates automatic cache removal and omits the open-panel gate message. The listing omits the §2 limit about positions copied into standalone analysis.
issues.fix: Align the disclosures with actual eviction and gated navigation, and include the fair-play limit already documented in the README.

issues.problem: The stale-result regression never exercises a move change that leaves Explain as the only available ask.
issues.fix: Extend the browser test to move from a Best result to a selected mating move, then assert the one-action re-ask is Explain and sends the correct pre-move payload.
